institution: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow (Apex Trauma Centre)
citation: SGPGIMS Hospital Infection Control Committee (SHICCOM). Hospital Infection Control Newsletter: Healthcare without infection, Volume 5, July to December 2022. Spotlight, Apex Trauma Centre: antibiogram of common bacterial pathogens recovered in all samples (July to December 2022). Lucknow: SGPGIMS.
reporting: Percent susceptible for the common bacterial pathogens of all samples (respiratory, blood, pus, urine) at the Apex Trauma Centre, locations together, with the number of isolates per organism; organism counts by specimen from the distribution charts; "-" means not tested.
method: First isolate from any sample only; diagnostic isolates, not surveillance; drugs routinely tested. AST method and breakpoints not stated.

verification.note: Both tables on p 2 read from the PDF text layer (word positions per column) and compared value by value with the rendered page image; organism counts read from the legends of Figs 3 to 8 on the page images (2026-09-26).

notes: Unit antibiogram of the SGPGIMS Apex Trauma Centre, Lucknow, July to December 2022 (152 positive cultures: respiratory 65, blood 37, pus 32, urine 18; 115 Gram negative, 37 Gram positive), from the SHICCOM Hospital Infection Control Newsletter (5th edition). All specimens and all locations are pooled in the tables (mapped to all specimens, all locations; the document does not split wards and ICU). The per-specimen charts give pus 33 and urine 17 isolates where Fig 1 gives 32 and 18. Only A. baumannii has 30 or more isolates (the newsletter itself notes the 30-isolate minimum).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: every cell of Tables 1 and 2 (p 2) re-read by eye from page renders (scale 4 to 6, the data rows again at scale 7 to 9) and written down before comparing with the file: all 75 cells, all 7 row n (24, 7, 4, 47, 17, 17, 12) with organism, specimen and setting, and all 27 counts (legends of Figs 3 to 8, pp 1 and 2). 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected. The "-" cells are rightly left out.

Second reader: the validator's cells are printed that way: CoNS ampicillin-sulbactam 13 against cefoxitin 4 (suppressed), E. faecalis gentamicin 50 and A. baumannii ertapenem 0 (intrinsic), K. pneumoniae imipenem 37 against meropenem 11 (caution).

Second reader: count cross-check: the per-specimen charts (Figs 5 to 8) add up to 1 fewer than the Fig 3 totals for A. baumannii (46 of 47), K. pneumoniae (16 of 17) and P. aeruginosa (16 of 17); the missing isolates may sit in the "Others" slices, so this is not a clear contradiction, and the counts stay as printed. Figs 6 and 7 total 17 urine and 33 pus isolates where Fig 1 prints 18 and 32 (already in notes).
Second reader: specimen and setting as printed: "all samples" of the Apex Trauma Centre (Fig 1: respiratory 65, blood 37, pus 32, urine 18) with no location split, so spec all and set all are right.
Lead 2026-09-26: a single-department antibiogram, given a focus ("Covers the Apex Trauma Centre only"): shown, never pooled with hospital-wide antibiograms, not a profile.
